Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Keysborough

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Keysborough. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

We know what the south-east's heat, UV and hailstorms do to a roof over the years, so we quote on what your home actually needs. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Keysborough: What We Commonly See

Keysborough is a real mix of established post-war homes and newer estate housing, with some light industrial along its edges. The older homes have roofs that are faded and weathered after decades of sun, while the newer estates are largely COLORBOND®.

Inland and storm-exposed, the wear comes from hot summers, harsh UV and the south-east's hailstorms rather than salt. The jobs we are called out for most in Keysborough are refixing cracked ridge capping, storm and hail damage, and replacing tired guttering and valleys on the older homes.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Keysborough

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Keysborough homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and built to handle Melbourne's heat, UV and hailstorms, in a colour that suits your home.

Thinking about going metal? We also handle tile to tin conversions, swapping a heavy, high-maintenance roof for lightweight metal. If your roof has widespread leaks, sagging or badly rusted sheeting, talk to us about a re-roof before you keep paying for patch jobs. We will give you a straight answer on what makes the most sense for your home and budget.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Keysborough

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that let water in: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. After a hailstorm or a run of hot summers these are often the first things to fail, and we trace each leak back to its real source rather than patching the ceiling stain.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Keysborough

Every roof is different, so we quote on what is actually in front of us rather than a one-size-fits-all price. The main things that move the cost are the size and pitch of the roof, the roofing material you choose, how much guttering and flashing is involved, and how easy the roof is to access safely. We will walk you through exactly what your quote covers so there are no surprises.

Our Keysborough Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Keysborough Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Keysborough locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Keysborough Roofing FAQs

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.

Suburbs We Service Near Keysborough

We also work on roofs in nearby Dandenong, Springvale, Noble Park, Lyndhurst and Dandenong South.
